_comment: Golden ProviderResourceDescriptor for GitHub (#523): a repository resource exposed by the integrations provider. Provider-neutral discovery fact with capabilities, permission, freshness, and screened namespaced extension metadata.
_expected_behavior: accepted — describes a discoverable GitHub repository without governance, review, or binding authority
_authority_boundary: Provisional alpha provider-fact handoff object. It is NOT a SourceBinding, Source, SourceSnapshot, SourceEvidence, DecisionCandidate, review command, signoff, compliance, or event-store authority object. provider_metadata holds only screened, non-authoritative provider facts.
